name: spreadsheet
description: Inspect, read, create, and update bounded XLSX workbooks through the model tool.

interface.shortDescription: Work with XLSX files in the current workspace.
interface.longDescription: Give the model bounded XLSX inspection, range reading, creation, and update capabilities. Desktop workbook preview is an independent application capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the spreadsheet capability when the task requires inspecting, reading, creating, or updating an XLSX workbook.
